saints.name: St. Maria Goretti
saints.title: Virgin and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: A poor Italian girl of eleven who died defending her purity and forgave her killer…
biography: Maria Goretti was born in 1890 to a poor farming family near Ancona; after her father's death the family shared a house with the Serenelli family in the Pontine Marshes. In July 1902, at not quite twelve years old, she was attacked by the young Alessandro Serenelli; resisting his assault, she was stabbed many times and died the next day.

Before she died she forgave her attacker and prayed for his conversion. Alessandro, imprisoned, was later converted after a dream of Maria and testified at the process for her cause; her mother was present at the canonization in 1950, the first mother to witness the canonization of her own child.
saints.knownFor: Her forgiveness of her killer and the defense of her purity.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. Maria Goretti (vatican.va)
